name: Anduin Wrynn
summary: Stormwind's throne rests with ten-year-old Anduin Wrynn while his father, King Varian Wrynn, is missing. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the royal court bear the work of governing.

sections.title: A Boy on the Throne
sections.body: Anduin Wrynn was born in the peace after the Second War. His name honors his grandfather, King Llane, and Sir Anduin Lothar, the legendary knight. When King Varian Wrynn vanished on the way to a diplomatic summit in Theramore, Anduin was crowned to keep the kingdom steady. Clever and compassionate, he is still only ten and has little say in affairs of state. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and royal councilor Lady Katrana Prestor share the work of ruling the realm.

sections.title: A Pawn in the Court
sections.body: Stormwind Keep holds Anduin as tension grows at court. Highlord Bolvar watches over the kingdom's defenses and works to keep it whole. Lady Katrana Prestor presses her counsel upon the court and undermines troop deployments to outlying human settlements. Anduin feels how fragile his court has become and longs for his father. For now, nobles with designs of their own and guardians surround the young king.

faq.q: Why is a child ruling Stormwind?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn vanished under mysterious circumstances while sailing to a diplomatic summit in Theramore. To prevent a succession crisis and preserve order across the realm, ten-year-old Prince Anduin was crowned king, and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon was named regent to govern in his place.

faq.q: Who actually runs the kingdom right now?
faq.answer: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is Regent of Stormwind. He commands the realm's armies and holds executive power until Anduin comes of age. Lady Katrana Prestor is a senior advisor whose influence reaches deep into the royal court and the House of Nobles.
Anduin's name honors two heroes of Stormwind's history: his grandfather, the fallen King Llane Wrynn, and Sir Anduin Lothar, the Lion of Azeroth who led the Alliance during the First and Second Wars.

faq.q: Where is Anduin located in the city?
faq.answer: King Anduin sits on the royal throne in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and Lady Katrana Prestor are close beside him.

angles.text: To Alliance citizens and soldiers, King Anduin is an innocent emblem of the realm's resilience. Many fear his youth leaves the throne open to court intrigue.
For Stormwind's people, the boy-king keeps the Wrynn dynasty alive while his father, Varian, is missing.
